name: 文長分散
description: 分析します 文の長さ 分布 for AI 検出.
useCase: 均一な文構造によるAIテキストの識別
mechanism: 測定します the 係数 of variation in row-level energy パターン as a proxy for 文の長さ diversity. AI tends to produce sentences of more uniform length.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
parameters: ウィンドウサイズ: 適応型, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: エントロピー, CV, 相関
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成の text
- Language-agnostic 統計的 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 誤検出
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies にわたる 文体s

references.title: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
Ippolito, D. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Generated Text is Easiest when Humans are Fooled. ACL.
